name: solidity-session-key-wallet
title: Scoped session key wallet
description: Owner-controlled native wallet with target-scoped session keys, cumulative spending budgets, expiry and nonce sequencing.
assumptions: Direct session-key transactions, not ERC4337 or EIP712 relaying. Budget limits native value only: calls to approved targets can manipulate tokens or other permissions, so allowlists must be narrowly selected. Reconfiguring a key invalidates old target authorizations. Owner retains unrestricted execution.
